text_block_list.text:
In an unforgiving GⅠ race where excuses 
mean nothing, Haru Urara went and seized 
1st place.

Hearing the cheers erupt for Haru Urara 
all around, she truly felt that she had 
earned the right to run in the Arima 
Kinen.

On the way home, Special Week and Seiun 
Sky, having watched Haru Urara's race, 
come by to encourage her.

Upon learning that the two of them would 
also enter the Arima Kinen, Haru Urara 
declared she wouldn't lose to her rivals.
